en.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西登基的時候年十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母親名叫協西巴。

en.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法耶和華在以色列人面前趕出的外邦人所行可憎的事。

en.text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

zhSimplified.text: 重新建筑他父希西家所毁坏的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做亚舍拉像，效法以色列王亚哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的万象；

zhTraditional.text: 重新建築他父希西家所毀壞的邱壇，又為巴力築壇，做亞舍拉像，效法以色列王亞哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的萬象；

en.text: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

zhSimplified.text: 在耶和华殿宇中筑坛。耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」

zhTraditional.text: 在耶和華殿宇中築壇。耶和華曾指着這殿說：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」

en.text: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，

zhTraditional.text: 他在耶和華殿的兩院中為天上的萬象築壇，

en.text: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

zhSimplified.text: 并使他的儿子经火，又观兆，用法术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气；

zhTraditional.text: 並使他的兒子經火，又觀兆，用法術，立交鬼的和行巫術的，多行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹動他的怒氣；

en.text: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

zhSimplified.text: 又在殿内立雕刻的亚舍拉像。耶和华曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 又在殿內立雕刻的亞舍拉像。耶和華曾對大衛和他兒子所羅門說：「我在以色列眾支派中所選擇的耶路撒冷和這殿，必立我的名，直到永遠。

en.text: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人若谨守遵行我一切所吩咐他们的和我仆人摩西所吩咐他们的一切律法，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人若謹守遵行我一切所吩咐他們的和我僕人摩西所吩咐他們的一切律法，我就不再使他們挪移離開我所賜給他們列祖之地。」

en.text: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 他们却不听从。玛拿西引诱他们行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。

zhTraditional.text: 他們卻不聽從。瑪拿西引誘他們行惡，比耶和華在以色列人面前所滅的列國更甚。

en.text: The LORD spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华借他仆人众先知说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華藉他僕人眾先知說：

en.text: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

zhSimplified.text: 「因犹大王玛拿西行这些可憎的恶事比先前亚摩利人所行的更甚，使犹大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪里；

zhTraditional.text: 「因猶大王瑪拿西行這些可憎的惡事比先前亞摩利人所行的更甚，使猶大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪裏；

en.text: therefore the LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

zhSimplified.text: 所以耶和华—以色列的 神如此说：我必降祸与耶路撒冷和犹大，叫一切听见的人无不耳鸣。

zhTraditional.text: 所以耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說：我必降禍與耶路撒冷和猶大，叫一切聽見的人無不耳鳴。

en.text: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

zhSimplified.text: 我必用量撒马利亚的准绳和亚哈家的线铊拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦净耶路撒冷，如人擦盘，将盘倒扣。

zhTraditional.text: 我必用量撒馬利亞的準繩和亞哈家的線鉈拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦淨耶路撒冷，如人擦盤，將盤倒扣。

en.text: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

zhSimplified.text: 我必弃掉所余剩的子民，把他们交在仇敌手中，使他们成为一切仇敌掳掠之物；

zhTraditional.text: 我必棄掉所餘剩的子民，把他們交在仇敵手中，使他們成為一切仇敵擄掠之物；

en.text: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

zhSimplified.text: 是因他们自从列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看为恶的事，惹动我的怒气。」

zhTraditional.text: 是因他們自從列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看為惡的事，惹動我的怒氣。」

en.text: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，使犹大人陷在罪里，又流许多无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，使猶大人陷在罪裏，又流許多無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷，從這邊直到那邊。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西其余的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都写在犹大列王记上。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西其餘的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都寫在猶大列王記上。

en.text: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内；他儿子亚们接续他作王。 （代下33·21—25）

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西與他列祖同睡，葬在自己宮院烏撒的園內；他兒子亞們接續他作王。 （代下33‧21－25）

en.text: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

zhSimplified.text: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。

zhTraditional.text: 亞們登基的時候年二十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母親名叫米舒利密，是約提巴人哈魯斯的女兒。

en.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

zhSimplified.text: 亚们行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；

zhTraditional.text: 亞們行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，與他父親瑪拿西所行的一樣；

en.text: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

zhSimplified.text: 行他父亲一切所行的，敬奉他父亲所敬奉的偶像，

zhTraditional.text: 行他父親一切所行的，敬奉他父親所敬奉的偶像，

en.text: and he abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 离弃耶和华—他列祖的 神，不遵行耶和华的道。

zhTraditional.text: 離棄耶和華－他列祖的上帝，不遵行耶和華的道。

en.text: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

zhSimplified.text: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。

zhTraditional.text: 亞們王的臣僕背叛他，在宮裏殺了他。

en.text: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 但國民殺了那些背叛亞們王的人，立他兒子約西亞接續他作王。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 亚们其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

zhTraditional.text: 亞們其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。

en.text: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 亚们葬在乌撒的园内自己的坟墓里。他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 亞們葬在烏撒的園內自己的墳墓裏。他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
